title: Per-View Gaussian Predictions Enable Training-Free Distractor Filtering in Feed-Forward 3DGS
abstract: arXiv:2608.26951v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructs an explicit Gaussian representation from multiple input images in one network execution, making 3D reconstruction increasingly accessible for casual captures. However, such captures frequently contain transient objects that appear in only a subset of the views. Such content can be encoded into the per-view Gaussians associated with the inputs that observe it and remain in the combined representation despite being observed by no other input. As a result, it may produce blurred, duplicated, or floating artifacts in novel views. We introduce a training-free filtering procedure that exploits this per-view prediction structure. For each input, we exclude its associated Gaussians and render the same camera using the remaining representation, revealing content that is inconsistent with the other inputs. translated_title: 基于每视图高斯预测的无训练干扰物过滤在前馈3D高斯泼溅中的应用
translated_abstract: 前馈3D高斯泼溅（Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting）在一次网络执行中，从多张输入图像重建出显式的高斯表示，使得三维重建对日常拍摄越来越便捷。然而，这类拍摄常常包含仅在部分视图中出现的瞬态物体。这些内容可能被编码到与观测到它们的输入相关联的每视图高斯中，并保留在组合表示中，尽管其他输入并未观测到它们。因此，这可能导致在新视图中产生模糊、重复或漂浮的伪影。我们提出了一种无需训练即可执行的过滤程序，利用这种每视图预测结构。对于每个输入，我们排除其关联的高斯，并用剩余表示渲染同一相机视角，从而揭示与其他输入不一致的内容。特征相似性形成候选区域，基于渲染的验证仅保留与观测一致的内容。
tldr: 提出一种无需训练的后处理过滤方法，通过逐视图排除和渲染验证，有效去除前馈3D高斯泼溅中由瞬态物体引入的干扰伪影。
en_tdlr: A training-free filtering method is proposed that removes transient-object artifacts in feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting by per-view exclusion and rendering-based verification.
